title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Form of the Registry Credit Bonus
content:
On a Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, the registry credit bonus on an order line to which the registrant applies registry credit takes its form from the line's item on the registry. The bonus percent is the registry credit bonus percent the line receives, in percentage points (zero when the line receives none).

- **Requested units still open.** For an item with an item entry whose most recent item entry's requested quantity is above the number of its guest gift entries, the bonus stretches the credit: the credit drawn is the amount still to be paid divided by one plus the bonus percent.
- **Requested units all given.** For an item with an item entry whose guest gift entries reach the requested quantity of its most recent item entry, the bonus is a reduction on at most the bonus base of **USD 200.00**: the credit drawn is the amount still to be paid less the bonus percent of the smaller of that amount and USD 200.00.
- **Item not on the registry.** For an item without an item entry there is no bonus, and the credit drawn is the amount still to be paid.

The requested quantity is that of the item's most recent item entry; the guest gift entries counted are all guest gift entries of that item on the registry.

## Worked lines (hypothetical bonus percent of 4)

| Item on the registry | Requested / guest gift entries | Amount still to be paid | Credit drawn |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | 4 / 1 | USD 260.00 | USD 260.00 divided by 1.04, USD 250.00 |
| yes | 2 / 2 | USD 260.00 | USD 260.00 less 4 percent of USD 200.00, USD 252.00 |
| yes | 2 / 3 | USD 150.00 | USD 150.00 less 4 percent of USD 150.00, USD 144.00 |
| no | — | USD 260.00 | USD 260.00 |

## Points of judgement

- "Reach" includes equality: guest gift entries equal to the requested quantity take the reduction form.
- The reduction is never taken on more than USD 200.00 of the amount, however large the line.
